raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Under a breakable prefill CUDA graph, `handle_attention_trtllm_mla` sends every extend down the MLA path, and `TRTLLMMLABackend` falls back to FlashInfer MLA metadata. That forfeits TRT-LLM's ragged MHA prefill for every model dispatched through `DeepseekV2AttentionMLA` with `trtllm_mla` as the prefill backend.

Chunked-KV MHA could not simply be enabled there. The eager attention break replays with the ForwardBatch captured at graph-capture time, so the cached-prefix metadata it sees is stale.

## Modifications

- One eager region per layer (`forward_mha.py`): under breakable graphs, run suffix and cached-prefix attention together in a single `eager_on_graph` region. The region:
  - reads the live ForwardBatch from the forward context instead of the captured one;
  - trims the bucket padding (`global_num_token_non_padded_cpu`) before attention and zero-pads the output back to the bucket shape;
  - skips attention entirely on an idle replay (zero real tokens);
  - runs its backend calls under `force_eager_attention()`, so RadixAttention does not insert nested breaks.
- Output projection stays captured: the output projection (and optional gate) moves out of `_forward_normal_chunked_kv_attention` and into the caller, so it stays in the captured segment after the break. As a side effect, the fused-prefix path now applies `gate` like the unfused path does. Only Bailing-V3 passes a gate, and only the Triton backend enables fused prefix, so this is a no-op for `trtllm_mla`.
- Dispatch (`attention_backend_handler.py`): the graph fixes the forward method at capture time, but whether a replay has a cached prefix varies. So under breakable graphs:
  - extend-without-speculative uses chunked KV;
  - with `--disable-chunked-prefix-cache`, extend keeps the MLA/FlashInfer fallback (the backend's fallback condition is updated to match);
  - `tokenspeed_mla` stays on MLA, since its prefill kernel has not been validated as an eager region.
- Runner (`prefill_cuda_graph_runner.py`): restore `mha_one_shot=False` and pass copies of the per-request CPU length lists on replay when this path is active.

Scope: the change applies whenever a breakable prefill graph runs with `trtllm_mla` as the prefill backend. By default, `cuda_graph_hook.py` turns breakable prefill graphs off for DeepSeek-V3 on `trtllm_mla` and for KDA hybrids such as Kimi K3. For those models the change takes effect only with an explicit `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable`. Revisiting the DeepSeek-V3 default is left to a follow-up.

## Accuracy Tests

- `test/registered/unit/models/test_deepseek_mha_breakable_prefix.py`: 4/4 pass. They cover the live batch, trimming and padding, skipping idle replays, and projecting after the break.
- `test/registered/unit/models/test_deepseek_mla_dispatch.py`: 9/9 pass, including the new breakable-graph dispatch cases (chunked KV with or without a prefix, and the MLA fallback with `disable_chunked_prefix_cache`).
- On current `main`, the four eager-region tests and the chunked-KV dispatch case fail.

GSM8K eval run through `sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k` with DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat:

| Setup | GSM8K accuracy |
|---|---|
| `main`, breakable prefill graph (MLA fallback) | 0.662 |
| this PR, breakable prefill graph | 0.658 |
| `main`, prefill graph disabled | 0.654 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Setup above, both arms with `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable`:

| KV cache | Workload | `main` mean TTFT | This PR mean TTFT |
|---|---|---|---|
| FP8 | random 1024-token prompts | 670 ms | **342 ms** |
| FP8 | 4096 shared prefix + 256 new | 603 ms | **487 ms** |
| BF16 | random 1024-token prompts | 329 ms | 337 ms |
| BF16 | 512 shared prefix + 2048 new | 670 ms | 676 ms |
| BF16 | 1024 shared prefix + 1024 new | 451 ms | 482 ms |
| BF16 | 4096 shared prefix + 256 new | 327 ms | 495 ms |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). N/A: no user-facing option changed.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+import unittest
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_common.attention_forward_methods import (
+    forward_mha,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=1, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestDeepseekMHABreakablePrefix(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_eager_region_uses_live_batch_and_fixed_shape_bridge(self):
+        capture_batch = SimpleNamespace(global_num_token_non_padded_cpu=8)
+        live_batch = SimpleNamespace(global_num_token_non_padded_cpu=5)
+        force_depth = 0
+        calls = []
+
+        @contextmanager
+        def fake_force_eager_attention():
+            nonlocal force_depth
+            force_depth += 1
+            try:
+                yield
+            finally:
+                force_depth -= 1
+
+        class FakeAttention:
+            def _forward_normal_chunked_kv_attention(self, q, k, v, forward_batch):
+                calls.append(
+                    (
+                        q.shape[0],
+                        k.shape[0],
+                        v.shape[0],
+                        forward_batch,
+                        force_depth,
+                    )
+                )
+                return q + 10
+
+        q = torch.arange(8 * 2 * 3, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(8, 2, 3)
+        k = q + 100
+        v = q + 200
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(
+                forward_mha,
+                "get_tc_piecewise_forward_context",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(forward_batch=live_batch),
+            ),
+            mock.patch.object(
+                forward_mha,
+                "force_eager_attention",
+                fake_force_eager_attention,
+            ),
+        ):
+            output = forward_mha._bcg_mha_chunked_kv_attention(
+                FakeAttention(), q, k, v, capture_batch
+            )
+
+        self.assertEqual(calls, [(5, 5, 5, live_batch, 1)])
+        self.assertEqual(output.shape, q.shape)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output[:5], q[:5] + 10)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output[5:], torch.zeros_like(output[5:]))
+        self.assertEqual(force_depth, 0)
+
+    def test_eager_region_skips_attention_for_idle_replay(self):
+        class FakeAttention:
+            num_local_heads = 2
+            v_head_dim = 5
+
+            def _forward_normal_chunked_kv_attention(self, *args):
+                raise AssertionError("an idle replay must not launch attention")
+
+        q = torch.ones((4, 2, 3))
+        live_batch = SimpleNamespace(global_num_token_non_padded_cpu=0)
+        with mock.patch.object(
+            forward_mha,
+            "get_tc_piecewise_forward_context",
+            return_value=SimpleNamespace(forward_batch=live_batch),

+            output = forward_mha._bcg_mha_chunked_kv_attention(

+
+    def test_core_keeps_output_projection_after_single_eager_region(self):
+        events = []
+        eager_output = torch.arange(4 * 2 * 3, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(4, 2, 3)
+        projected = torch.full((4, 7), 9.0)
+
+        class FakeAttention(forward_mha.DeepseekMHAForwardMixin):
+            num_local_heads = 2
+            v_head_dim = 3
+
+            def _forward_normal_chunked_kv_attention(self, *args):
+                raise AssertionError("BCG must use the eager attention region")
+
+            def o_proj(self, value):
+                events.append(("o_proj", value.shape))
+                return projected, None
+
+        def fake_eager_region(attn, q, k, v, forward_batch):
+            events.append(("attention", forward_batch))
+            return eager_output
+
+        q = k = v = torch.empty((4, 2, 3))
+        forward_batch = object()
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(
+                forward_mha,
+                "is_in_breakable_cuda_graph",
+                return_value=True,
+            ),
+            mock.patch.object(
+                forward_mha,
+                "bcg_mha_chunked_kv_attention",
+                side_effect=fake_eager_region,
+            ) as eager_region,
+        ):
+            output = FakeAttention().forward_normal_chunked_kv_core(
+                q, k, v, forward_batch
+            )
+
+        self.assertIs(output, projected)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            events,
+            [

+                ("o_proj", torch.Size([4, 6])),

+    def test_fused_prefix_projects_output_exactly_once(self):
+        calls = []
+
+        class FakeAttention(forward_mha.DeepseekMHAForwardMixin):

+
+            def _fused_prefix_extend_attn_mha(self, q, k, v, batch):

+            mock.patch.object(
+                forward_mha, "resolve_attn_backend", return_value=object()
+            ),
+            mock.patch.object(
+                forward_mha, "use_fused_prefix_extend", return_value=True

+        self.assertEqual(calls, [torch.Size([4, 6])])
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output, q.reshape(4, 6) + 10)

+class TestTRTLLMMLABreakableDispatch(CustomTestCase):
+    """A breakable prefill graph fixes the method at capture for every replay."""
+
+    def _dispatch(self, *, disable_chunked_prefix_cache: bool, prefix: int):
+        attn = SimpleNamespace(
+            disable_chunked_prefix_cache=disable_chunked_prefix_cache
+        )

+        )

+            mock.patch.object(abh, "is_in_tc_piecewise_cuda_graph", return_value=False),

+            return abh.handle_attention_trtllm_mla(attn, batch)
+
+    def test_extend_uses_chunked_kv_regardless_of_prefix(self):

+            with self.subTest(prefix=prefix):

+                    AttnForwardMethod.MHA_CHUNKED_KV,
+                )

+    def test_disabled_chunked_prefix_cache_keeps_mla(self):

+        # replay, which does not exist without chunked prefix cache.
+        for prefix in (0, 32):
+            with self.subTest(prefix=prefix):
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    self._dispatch(disable_chunked_prefix_cache=True, prefix=prefix),
